metadata.benchmark_description: Empirical validation of FLAN-T5 optimization (L1 Unstructured Pruning & PyTorch Dynamic INT8 Quantization)
metadata.model_checkpoint_source: google/flan-t5-small (pre-trained Google base checkpoint, zero-shot on task)

timing_procedure.scope: model.generate() autoregressive token generation alone (excludes preprocessing and decoding)

results.observations: Zero-shot baseline on clinical extraction prompts.

20% global L1 magnitude pruning made permanent via prune.remove(). Dense memory layout is unchanged without sparse kernels. CPU latency increased by +87.3%. Generation collapsed completely without post-pruning recovery fine-tuning.

results.parameter_counting_note: 16.47M reflects unquantized float parameters (embeddings, norms); quantized linear weights are stored in C++ _packed_params and omitted by model.parameters(). Total parameter count remains 76.96M.
results.observations: INT8 dynamic quantization reduced serialized disk storage by 58.9% (293.66 MB to 120.71 MB) and retained 94.75% of baseline zero-shot ROUGE-1. However, CPU inference latency increased by +67.0% (115.96 ms to 193.64 ms) due to per-step dynamic dequantization overhead in PyTorch eager mode on this CPU.
